terminal_name: Virginia LNG Terminal (gem.wiki page, no tracker row)
issue: gem.wiki coverage cross-check (Discovery SOP §4.0b): 'Virginia LNG Terminal' sits in gem.wiki's 'LNG terminals in South Africa' category but has NO row in the export CSV. Independent research: this is the Renergen/Tetra4 Virginia Gas Project (Free State, inland; acquired by ASP Isotopes in Jan 2026) — a domestic small-scale LNG + liquid-helium plant whose LNG is distributed inland (virtual pipeline/trucking); Phase 1 targeted ~2,500 GJ/day LNG in Q3 2026 (verified: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/06/23/3315880/0/en/ASP-Isotopes-Inc-Announces-that-a-Subsidiary-of-Renergen-Limited-Has-Entered-into-its-First-Take-or-Pay-Contract-for-the-Supply-of-Contained-Helium-to-be-Produced-at-the-Virginia-G.html). No marine LNG import/export link found in any source, so the project FAILS the scope gate (domestic-only) and its absence from the tracker appears correct — but the gem.wiki page/category placement is inconsistent with that exclusion.
suggested_action: Confirm with GEM staff that Virginia's exclusion from the tracker is intentional (domestic-only, out of scope) and consider recategorizing/annotating the gem.wiki page so it stops reading as a tracker coverage gap. Do NOT add a tracker row unless a marine LNG link emerges.

terminal_name: Mossel Bay FSRU / Coega FSRU / Richards Bay FSRU / Saldanha Bay FSRU
issue: Revival check of all four cancelled South Africa sites found NO new project activity. Mossel Bay FSRU (cancelled 2014, high priority): no LNG-terminal revival — the PetroSA–Gazprombank Africa refinery-revival deal reportedly neared collapse by Jan 2025 and no new import-terminal proposal exists. The three Karpowership sites (Coega, Richards Bay, Saldanha Bay, cancelled 2024): the Karpowership deal is definitively over (2025 Pretoria High Court ruling invalidated the mooring licence; Eskom cancelled grid access) with no successor project at any of the three sites. All 2025-2026 South African LNG activity maps to existing GEM records: Zululand Energy Terminal (= Richards Bay Transnet FSRU; Eskom LNG agreement + ExxonMobil supply arrangement, June 2026), Ukwanda/TNPA Ngqura (= Ngqura LNG Terminal), and Vitol/ACWA Durban (= Durban LNG Terminal).
suggested_action: No action — recorded so the sweep's dead-site revival checks are auditable. Cancelled records stay as-is.
